decks.summary: Zero-skill Mark who uses Sophie's +2 in place of skill cards and draws off the damage, fighting with Machete and Beat Cop, covering partners with "Let me handle this!" and Taunt, and healing with First Aid.

Beginner Mark from Core, Dunwich, Carcosa and Edge of the Earth: .32 Colts and Sledgehammer with Bandolier, Beat Cop and Sophie to pass any test, "Let me handle this!" to pull enemies off his partner.

Firearm Mark who stacks Custom Modifications and Enchant Weapon on a .45 Thompson, keeps it firing with Reliable and Well-Maintained, and heals himself through Trusted and Second Wind; a top-tier fighter.
Sniper Mark built to make the Springfield M1903 work, starting on .35 Winchesters, .32 Colts and a Bandolier, with Hiding Spot and Warning Shot to keep enemies off the team.

Boss-killer Mark for Expert: Practice Makes Perfect fetches Vicious Blow, Overpower and The Home Front, .45 Thompsons with Venturer keep the ammo coming, and Stand Together and Leadership help the team.
Solo Carcosa Mark tuned over forty plays: Machete and the .45, Scene of the Crime and Shortcut for clues on the move, and an upgrade path to Stick to the Plan, Key of Ys and Brother Xavier.
Frontline Mark who heals rather than soaks: First Aid, Emergency Aid and Smoking Pipe repair Sophie's damage, Taunt and True Grit protect the team, and Machete does the killing.
Flex Mark who investigates twice a turn with two Crowbars on a Tool Belt, boosted by Wolf Mask, and fights with Blessed Blade, Beat Cops and Hunter's Mark.
Hard-difficulty Mark: .45 Thompson and Enchanted Blade put him near 9 to fight, Sophie passes tests, heavy draw keeps him stocked, and Emergency Aid, Second Wind and Hallowed Mirror heal it all.
Starter Mark who fights with two .32 Colts, a .45 Automatic, Machete and Beat Cop, draws off the damage he takes, and pulls enemies off partners with "Let me handle this!"; Flashlight for clues.
